subject.title: fix(agents): dripping proxy SSE bodies cancel via outer abort

question: Should `ProxyStreamOptions` gain an opt-in proxy-local total-stream deadline in addition to the existing outer abort signal?
rationale: The stated behavior is already enforced by the existing outer signal and demonstrated by the new loopback regression; retaining the option would establish a second lifetime policy without a current caller.

options.title: Narrow to regression proof
options.body: Remove `streamDeadlineMs` and its deadline-only coverage while keeping the native outer-abort loopback regression.

options.title: Approve the lifetime API
options.body: Keep the option only after naming a production caller, documenting precedence with `signal` and `timeoutMs`, and adding caller-level compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Narrow to regression proof
recommendation.body: Remove `streamDeadlineMs` and its deadline-only coverage while keeping the native outer-abort loopback regression.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the proxy timing contract that this option would extend.
